assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic triggers and assess stroke risk.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is CPT 93229.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary.
The payer's letter confirms the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
This appeal requests that the appeal rights be reinstated within the specified timeframe.
